en: This is a vintage postcard depicting a busy market scene in a European square, with numerous people, mostly women and children, gathered around market stalls. The architecture of the buildings is classical European, with multi-story facades and shuttered windows. The image is black and white or sepia-toned, suggesting an early 20th-century or late 19th-century origin. In the upper right corner, text reads 'Trento Piazza della Posta' in red, and there is a handwritten name 'Isabella' on the right side. At the bottom, the name 'Luigi Marsoner, Trento' appears, likely the publisher or photographer.
